title: Extropian CAE Workbench
description: Extendable GL-based UI/UX workbench for configuring and running numerical solvers — the interface layer of the Extropian ecosystem.
tagline: An extendable, GL-based UI/UX workbench for configuring and running numerical solvers.
capabilities: Interactive scene-based editing of models, meshes, and boundary conditions
Batch process management and reproducible save/load of simulation scenes
Command-bus architecture separating UI from computational operations
Built directly on GL rendering for fluid, real-time interaction
foundation: The interface layer proven in the HyperFat hypersonic CFD engagement
Renders through Extropian Render and Extropian Spatial UI components
Configures and drives Extropian Physics solvers or your existing solver
Designed to be customized per solver or per domain workflow
body:
Extropian CAE Workbench is the application layer of the ecosystem: an extendable, GL-based workbench for configuring and running numerical solvers. It turns a powerful but developer-only solver into something engineers can drive — editing models and boundary conditions, managing batch processes, and saving and reloading scenes with reproducibility.

The workbench is the same interface technology in active use on the HyperFat hypersonic CFD engagement, and it is designed to be adapted to a different solver, mesh, or domain rather than rewritten.

title: Extropian Synthesis
description: Generative AI and optimization platform for synthesizing novel machines from known physics, geometry, and materials — Extropian Synthesis.
tagline: A generative AI and optimization powered platform for synthesizing known laws of nature, geometries, materials, and computational algorithms to invent novel machines at any scale.
capabilities: Generative synthesis grounded in known laws of nature rather than free-form generation
Combines physics, geometry, materials, and computational algorithms in one design loop
Optimization-driven exploration of machine concepts across scales
Built on the Extropian simulation and geometry foundations
foundation: Research-stage platform (direction of travel for the ecosystem's AI work)
Draws on Extropian Physics, Extropian Geometry, and Extropian Optimization
Designed to output designs that existing solvers can validate
body:
Extropian Synthesis is the ecosystem's generative design platform: instead of generating imagery or text, it synthesizes *machines* — combining known laws of nature, geometries, materials, and computational algorithms to invent novel designs at any scale.

The premise is that generated concepts are only useful when they can be simulated and validated. Synthesis is being built on the Extropian simulation stack so that every proposed design is checkable against real physics.

title: Extropian Spatial UI
description: Lightweight, performant 2D UI/UX system built directly into any GL context — deployable on any system.
tagline: A lightweight, performant 2D UI/UX system built directly into any GL context, deployable on any system.
capabilities: 2D UI/UX rendered inside the GL context — no DOM layer required
Lightweight enough for embedded and real-time environments
Performant interaction during live simulation and visualization
Deployable on any system that runs a GL context
foundation: The interaction layer under Extropian CAE Workbench interfaces
Pairs with Extropian Render for unified GL-based applications
Removes the traditional DOM/engine divide in engineering tools
body:
Most engineering software lives with a split personality: a native or DOM-based UI bolted onto a graphics engine. Extropian Spatial UI eliminates that divide by drawing the 2D interface directly inside the GL context — lightweight, performant, and deployable anywhere a GL context runs.

That makes it the interaction foundation for engineering tools that need UI and visualization to behave as one system.

title: Extropian Composer
description: Context-aware, interactive visualization of complex topics or systems — explain, explore, and communicate.
tagline: Context-aware, interactive visualization of complex topics or systems.
capabilities: Interactive composition of complex systems for exploration and communication
Context-aware presentation that adapts to what is being examined
Built on the Extropian rendering and interaction stack
Suited to digital-twin views, training, and technical communication
foundation: Renders through Extropian Render with Extropian Spatial UI interaction
Reuses the interactive-visualization patterns proven in engineering engagements
body:
Complex systems are hard to communicate. Extropian Composer is built for context-aware, interactive visualization of complex topics or systems — letting viewers explore relationships, states, and behavior instead of staring at static diagrams.

It shares its rendering and interaction foundation with the engineering tools, so a Composer view can sit on top of real simulation or sensor data rather than being a stylized mock.

title: Extropian Render
description: Modular ECS-based renderer with built-in interaction, shaders, and gizmo support for any GL backend.
tagline: A modular, ECS-based renderer with built-in interaction, shaders, and gizmo support for any GL backend.
capabilities: ECS-based scene architecture for large, dynamic engineering scenes
Built-in interaction, shaders, and gizmo support
Backend-agnostic — supports any GL context
Composable rendering pipeline for domain-specific visualization
foundation: The rendering core used by Extropian CAE Workbench and the demo pipeline
ECS design keeps scenes modular and extensible
Gizmo and interaction primitives built in rather than bolted on
body: Extropian Render is the visualization core of the ecosystem: a modular, ECS-based renderer with interaction, shaders, and gizmo support built in, and no loyalty to a single GL backend. Scenes are data — entities and components — which keeps engineering visualizations modular, extensible, and composable with the rest of the stack.

title: Extropian Geometry
description: A modular 2D and 3D parametric geometry engine — geometry as a foundation, not an add-on.
tagline: A modular, parametric geometry engine for 2D and 3D.
capabilities: Parametric 2D and 3D geometry construction and manipulation
Modular design that composes into larger modeling workflows
Feeds meshing, simulation, and visualization downstream
Foundation for generative design exploration
foundation: Core geometry layer beneath Extropian CAE, Physics, and Synthesis
Designed for the interactive performance engineering tools demand
body: Extropian Geometry is the shape foundation of the ecosystem: a modular, parametric 2D and 3D geometry engine. Rather than being an isolated CAD-style island, it is built to feed downstream consumers — meshing, simulation, visualization, and generative design — from one parametric description.

title: Extropian CAE
description: A modular, unified CAE format for representing any multiphysics problem — the data foundation of the ecosystem.
tagline: A modular, unified CAE format for representing any multiphysics problem.
capabilities: A single representation for multiphysics problems across the ecosystem
Modular format that grows with problem types rather than freezing them
Reproducible scenes: models, boundary conditions, and setup in one place
Exchangeable with existing solver and mesh tooling
foundation: The data backbone shared by Extropian CAE Workbench and Extropian Physics
Scene save/load with reproducibility (as used in the HyperFat engagement)
body:
Every engineering tool family eventually fights its own file formats. Extropian CAE is the ecosystem's answer: a modular, unified format for representing any multiphysics problem — geometry, mesh, physics, boundary conditions, and study setup in one reproducible structure.

Because the format is modular, it is designed to represent problem types that do not exist yet, not just the ones solved today.

title: Extropian Viz
description: Post-processing and visualization tooling for simulation results — turn solver output into insight.
tagline: Post-processing and visualization for simulation results.
capabilities: Post-processing of solver output into interactive visual results
Exploration of results across parameters and design comparisons
Built on the Extropian rendering stack with no legacy visualization debt
foundation: Complements Extropian Render with result-oriented visualization features
Pairs with Extropian CAE Workbench for full configure-solve-visualize loops
body: Solver output is only valuable when it can be seen, compared, and understood. Extropian Viz covers the post-processing side of the simulation loop — turning raw results into interactive visualizations engineers can explore and compare. It is being built on the same modern rendering stack as the rest of the ecosystem rather than on aging visualization toolkits.

title: Extropian Physics
description: Modular multiphysics numerical methods engine with GPU-first solvers and coupling strategies — Extropian Physics licensing, customization, and build-on options.
tagline: A modular numerical methods engine with multiphysics solvers and modular coupling strategies, built from the ground up for GPU compute workloads.
capabilities: Multiphysics solver architecture with modular coupling strategies
Numerical methods designed for GPU compute workloads from the ground up
Component-level solvers that combine into larger simulation systems
Real-time and interactive simulation potential (GPU-first design)
foundation: Written for GPU compute architectures (WebGL/WebGPU-era pipelines)
Modular, composable solver and coupling design
Powers the real-time simulation and visualization demos across the Extropian ecosystem
Ecosystem sibling to Extropian CAE (unified problem format) and Extropian Optimization
body:
Extropian Physics is the numerical heart of the ecosystem: a modular engine for building multiphysics simulations without locking you into a monolithic solver. It is designed around GPU compute from the first line of code, so workloads that traditionally require offline batch infrastructure can run interactive and real-time.

Because the engine is modular, an engagement rarely adopts it whole — more often a solver, a coupling strategy, or the GPU execution layer becomes the starting point for a specialized application.

title: Extropian Optimization
description: Modular optimization engine for engineering design spaces — Extropian Optimization licensing, customization, and build-on options.
tagline: A modular optimization engine for exploring larger design spaces and finding better-performing designs.
capabilities: Modular optimization engine that wraps simulation and analysis workflows
Turns manual iteration into automated design-space exploration
Plugs into existing solvers, models, and evaluation pipelines
Composable with generative and AI-driven search strategies
foundation: Modular optimizer core, independent of any single simulation package
Designed to sit on top of Extropian Physics or existing validated solvers
Pairs with Extropian Synthesis for generative design exploration
body:
Optimization turns engineering judgment loops into automated search. Extropian Optimization is a modular engine for driving simulations and analyses toward better designs with less manual effort — exploring design spaces that would be impractical to cover by hand.

Its modular design means the optimization layer can wrap your existing solver rather than requiring you to migrate to a new one.

title: Extropian Assets
description: A collection of assets for GL-based scenes — meshes, materials, and textures for engineering visualization.
tagline: A collection of assets for GL-based scenes.
capabilities: Meshes, materials, and textures for GL-based engineering scenes
Scene-ready assets that work with Extropian Render and Spatial UI
Grows with the ecosystem's demonstration and product needs
foundation: Asset library exercised by the ecosystem demos and product development
body: Every graphics pipeline needs content. Extropian Assets is the ecosystem's collection of meshes, materials, and textures for GL-based scenes — the practical content layer that keeps demos, products, and engagements from reinventing the same basic scene elements.

title: Extropian Core
description: The foundational C++ platform library of the ecosystem — math, memory, ECS, and GL integration primitives that every Extropian component builds on.
tagline: The foundational C++ platform library — math, memory, ECS, and GL integration primitives for the whole ecosystem.
capabilities: Core math, containers, and memory primitives for high-performance compute
ECS and scene-graph foundations shared by Render, Physics, and Spatial UI
GL integration primitives — context, resources, and backend abstraction
body:
**Extropian Core** is the shared foundation of the ecosystem: the C++ libraries every other Extropian component composes. It is open source under Apache 2.0 so teams can build their own software on the same primitives the products use.

Everything else in the ecosystem — Geometry, CAE, Physics, Render, Spatial UI — is built on Core and available as modular repositories that drop into your own codebase.
